notes.title: Bail Force is officially joining forces with Indie.io!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43998061/f8a09cc3816297c392a9ccfae840a26a696f2f24.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We have officially formed a new partnership with [u]indie.io[/u]! For our team, formed just from a circle of fellow gamers at the end of 2021, this is a blessing and a great opportunity to bring our love in making games to a global audience. Bail Force is an action roguelite game about two bounty hunters with conflicting goals who chase the same target, the most dangerous crime lord in the city. Built around our proprietary adaptive combat system, we are taking the roguelite gameplay to the next level by making how you kill an enemy to change your stats and the enemy’s stats and behavior to grow to symbolize the cycle of violence in a dystopian society.[/p][p][/p][p] We are just a group of friends who hold other jobs in our daily lives, making this game in our spare time, but the recognition and support I[u]ndie.io[/u] gives to our game motivates us to deliver and commit our work to a higher level, and indie.io have elevated many indie games to greater heights and reach. We hope to make our game become a beloved game with the help of indie.io.[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.[/p][p]
[/p][p]If you think Bail Force is the game for you, wishlist Bail Force! Don’t forget to follow i[u]ndie.io[/u]’s publisher page and our social media as well![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio"]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/SeblaccS"]https://x.com/SeblaccS[/url][/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/seblaccsoft.bsky.social"]https://bsky.app/profile/seblaccsoft.bsky.social[/url][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/NF9dsXXE"]https://discord.gg/NF9dsXXE[/url][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/@SeblaccSoft"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/bailforce"]https://www.facebook.com/bailforce[/url][/p][p][url="https://sites.google.com/view/seblaccsoft/"]https://sites.google.com/view/seblaccsoft/[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.instagram.com/seblaccsoft/"]https://www.instagram.com/seblaccsoft/[/url] [/p][p]

notes.title: April Development- More enemy types, obstacles, and Upgrades
notes.content:
Hello!
Our project is going smoothly and we are planning to add more enemy types, obstacles, and upgrades to ensure a richer gameplay.

Our Beta will be updated once the new features are set.

The day of release is drawing closer by the day. We pray for the best results and a great game that is fun to play.
Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Trailer 3 is Out!
notes.content: We have a new trailer in our store page! What do you think?

notes.title: Beta Demo is out!
notes.content:
Beta Demo is OUT!

Hi Gamers! 
Our Beta Demo is released now!
Featuring:
-Playable Angel
-Reworked all characters
-More enemy types
-More Add-on Types
-All New UI/UX and Menus
-Simplified Tutorial
-Story Cutscenes
-Adjusted Stats and Mechanics

Please tell us what you think about our demo in the community hub! We plan to release in April and any support and feedback is appreciated. If you like our demo, please spread the word about our game. You can stream it too if you like it.

Thanks and let us work on our final product release in April/May.

Best wishes to you all,


Seblacc Soft Team

notes.title: New Demo in January
notes.content:
We are about to release a new demo, incorporating changes from feedbacks we received so far.
We also hope we can release the final version of the game in April/May.
We'll keep doing our best, stay tuned for more updates.
Happy New Year 2025!

notes.title: Development is Progressing Well-Release has been Scheduled
notes.content:
Hi Hunters!
We have many good news, first, our team received the necessary funding so we can continue finishing this game, which will be in about 7-8 months.
Second, we are ensuring that our launch and next demos are up to the best quality we can. There will be also many exciting content alongside our game, including gorgeous merchandise and surprise event appearances in Indonesia. Please stay tuned for more surprises in the future.

notes.title: Our Heartfelt Thanks+Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
We would like to thank all of you who wishlisted Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty hunters during yesterday's PixElated Festival and those who wishlisted until now. We are currently preparing upcoming updates to our demo and final game:

-Playable Angel
-Opening Cutscenes
-Revamped level graphics (no more floating platforms)
-New Add-Ons and skill effects
-Better sound design

We are also preparing a cool surprise set in the Bail Force Universe, please stay tuned.
Sincerely yours,


Seblacc Soft

notes.title: Store Description Updated with New Systems Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
We are honored to announce the store page update with new systems. Please read early information on our Arrest/Vendetta System and Social Media system.

With this, we have completed the road map of what Bail Force will give the players when it's released and we shall work on completing the game.

We hope we can finish and deliver the game satisfactorily.

Thank you for your support so far!

notes.title: Overhaul in assets, levels, and new game systems incoming
notes.content:
Hello! How are you gamers doing?
We are planning a major update for our next demo.
There will be major overhauls, both in graphics and gameplay to truly showcase what Bail Force is.
Please stay tuned while we update the build.
Thank you.

notes.title: All-New UI on the way for April
notes.content:
We are preparing new UI and new resources for our April Demo. 
Look forward to it!

notes.title: New Demo on the way!
notes.content:
Our development team is now tweaking the game balance and preparing new assets.
The new demo, with thorough improvements in all areas, will be ready in April 2024.
Angel will be playable in the new demo and features requested by players will be available there.

notes.title: Moving Platform
notes.content:
To improve the platforming and combat experience, the moving platform is added to the game.
Combine the movements with jumping and dashing, and you can theoretically be untouchable to enemy fire.

The Acid Barrel hazard is also working perfectly, as seen in this picture.

notes.title: Map Hazards in Progress
notes.content:
Hello Hunters!
Our game's development is going strong!
We are now developing map hazards such as poison barrels, exploding barrels etc that can be a double-edged sword for you players. You can damage enemies with these but if you're not careful, you can also be damaged by the blast.

notes.title: New Feature soon
notes.content: The development is progressing smoothly this month. After that, we will be revealing a new feature sometime next month. We are also overhauling some enemy sprites.

notes.title: Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters Demo Livestream
notes.content:
Hello gamers! We are thrilled to bring you our game, Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters.

Bail Force is an action roguelite about two bounty hunters in a cyberpunk setting. Experience Adaptive Combat System where the enemy will learn from your fighting style and try to circumvent your advantages. Face the challenging next level of Action Roguelite experience.

See how Manda, our game designer, and Mr. Mukhlis Farhan, our lead programmer have fun with the game with the various add-ons, the combat, and our signature adaptive combat system!

notes.title: Watch the Developers Play: Bail Force Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters
notes.content:
Introducing Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters this Steam Next Fest.

Bail Force is an action roguelite about two bounty hunters in a cyberpunk setting. Experience Adaptive Combat System where the enemy will learn from your fighting style and try to circumvent your advantages. Face the challenging next level of Action Roguelite experience.

Mix and match add-ons to get the optimal combination for your character! Battle criminals, drones and robots operated by crime syndicates, and catch dangerous fugitives!

Join us, Download our Demo, and Wishlist our game!

notes.title: Demo Available this September
notes.content: Our demo will be available within the first two weeks of this September. Experience our signature Adaptive Combat System, glimpse into the beginning of the story, and battle dangerous enemies, Hunter!

notes.title: Story and Dialog system Update for Demo
notes.content: We are updating the story content and the dialog for our characters! Our demo will be ready soon. Stay Tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Hero Landing added, Demo Progress
notes.content:
We have completed adding Hero Landing, which will be the final skill included in our game demo.

We will be completing the demo in about three months for now. We are working on the boss character for the demo, building the second playable character (Angel), gameplay balancing, and the various UI/UX elements needed for a proper demo.
Wish us luck, for we are committed to bringing you the best demo that represents the game properly.

notes.title: Pain Blocker test
notes.content:
Pain Blocker

A Tactical-type add-on, Pain Blocker lets you block damage for 8 seconds once your HP reaches 30%.
Wishlist Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters on Steam now!

notes.title: Meet Marina!
notes.content:
Meet Marina!
She is our mission operator.

Her duty is to assist hunters during missions and to be in charge of the item shop in the base.

notes.title: Update: Acid Road effect added, Explosive Shot revamped.
notes.content:
We added Acid Road, an add-on embed to your dash. This add-on activates when you press the dash button. Unlike Flame Dash which procs damage rapidly and scales with STR, Acid Road scales with DEX and procs less often, but it bypasses enemy armor.

Explosive Shot is also revamped, we kind of reduced the bonus damage but increased the activation rate.

We will keep updating in the future. Stay tuned for Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters!
